### ✅ Accessibility & UX Checklist
- [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Used correct tags (e.g., `<button>`, `<label>`, `<h1>-<h6>`).
- [ ] **Bilingual Support:** Bengali content uses `lang="bn"` attribute.
- [ ] **ARIA Labels:** Icon-only buttons or ambiguous elements have `aria-label`.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation:** All interactive elements are reachable via Tab and have focus indicators.
- [ ] **Color Contrast:** Text and icons meet WCAG AA/AAA standards.
- [ ] **Loading States:** Async operations show progress/loading indicators.
- [ ] **Mobile Responsive:** Layout works correctly on smaller screens.
